Here is a factual research note on the event *“5,000 productive trees planted in Jakarta” (BRI Peduli Grow & Green initiative)* based on live sources. It focuses on what *has been done*, what remains to be measured, and distinguishes between completed outcomes and future goals.

---

## What *Actually Happened* (Completed/Measured Outcomes)

- PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk through its social & environmental responsibility program **BRI Peduli Grow & Green** has **planted 5,000 productive (fruit/usable) trees** at multiple locations in Jakarta. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- The planting ceremony took place at **Embung Pemuda, Jakarta** on **Friday, 30 October 2026**. Other planting sites include **TPS Badan Air** and **SMKN 74 Jakarta**. ([baliexpress.jawapos.com](https://baliexpress.jawapos.com/bisnis/2611210009/bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- The program covers full implementation of planting: from **design**, **seedling supply**, **planting**, **maintenance**, **data collection** of plant condition, to **measurement of carbon absorption potential**. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- To ensure survival and sustainability, BRI commits to **one year** of monitoring after planting, with a target that at the **12-month mark**, sides planted will have a **minimum survival rate of 80%**. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- Since the Grow & Green program was launched in **2023**, it has planted **over 155,000 tree seedlings**. The reported potential emissions absorption associated with those is **54.77 tons of CO₂e**. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  

---

## What Was *Announced Or Planned* (Not Yet Measured or Outcome Still Pending)

- The **survival rate target** of 80% at 12 months is a stated goal; performance toward that target has not (yet) been measured or reported. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- While carbon absorption potential is estimated (for all trees planted since 2023), actual carbon sequestration measured over time has not been documented. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- The benefit of the fruit or produce from the planted trees for the local community is projected (“diarahkan memberi manfaat …”) but it remains to be seen in practice. ([katadata.co.id](https://katadata.co.id/info/6b014ad91a861/bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-untuk-ketahanan-pangan?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Multiple Sources & Originality

- The **ANTARA News** article appears to be the original primary announcement. It provides detailed attribution, dates/times, and direct statements from BRI. ([antaranews.com](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/5869815/dukung-pemulihan-ekosistem-dan-ketahanan-pangan-bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  
- Multiple local news outlets (Katadata, TVOne, RMOL, Bali Express, etc.) have republished the event, largely repeating the same data (number of trees, locations, survival rate target, etc.), likely based on the same source material. ([rmol.id](https://rmol.id/read/2026/11/21/729167/bri-peduli-grow-green-tanam-5-000-pohon-produktif-di-jakarta?utm_source=openai))  

---

## Remaining Questions (What Is *Not* Documented Yet)

- Whether the **80% survival rate** target was achieved (measurement awaits)  
- Specific species of productive trees planted, and when they will start bearing fruit (if relevant)  
- Actual carbon absorption achieved so far (versus potential)  
- Details of community benefit (harvest/use of fruit) so far  

---

If you like, I can try to find the follow-up data in 12 months or assessments to see how successful the survival, fruit yield, and carbon impact turn out.

stories.research_notes:
Here is a fact-checked note on what is known about the claim that a drug “made pancreatic tumors disappear,” as of today (November 21, 2026).  

---

## What actually happened

1. **Drug involved**: *Daraxonrasib* an oral inhibitor targeting mutant KRAS, used in combination with chemotherapy. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Trial design / publication / approval**:
   - The pivotal clinical trial providing strong evidence was the **Phase III RASolute-302** study. It enrolled about 500 patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), who had received at least one prior therapy or were not candidates for multiagent therapy. ([dana-farber.org](https://www.dana-farber.org/newsroom/news-releases/2026/fda-approves-daraxonrasib-for-metastatic-pancreatic-cancer-following-landmark-clinical-trial-led-by-dana-farber?utm_source=openai))
   - Results from that trial were published in *The New England Journal of Medicine* and presented at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting. ([dana-farber.org](https://www.dana-farber.org/newsroom/news-releases/2026/fda-approves-daraxonrasib-for-metastatic-pancreatic-cancer-following-landmark-clinical-trial-led-by-dana-farber?utm_source=openai))
   - The drug was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in **August 2026** for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma in the specified setting. ([dana-farber.org](https://www.dana-farber.org/newsroom/news-releases/2026/fda-approves-daraxonrasib-for-metastatic-pancreatic-cancer-following-landmark-clinical-trial-led-by-dana-farber?utm_source=openai))

3. **Efficacy / outcomes**:
   - **Survival**: Median overall survival in the daraxonrasib arm was ~**13.2 months**, compared with ~**6.7 months** for standard chemotherapy. Thus, the drug almost doubled survival in this setting. ([bmj.com](https://www.bmj.com/content/393/bmj-2026-902114.full.pdf?utm_source=openai))
   - **Tumor shrinkage or disappearance** (“substantial tumor shrinkage or disappearance”): about **33.2%** in daraxonrasib group versus ~11–12% in chemotherapy group among patients with known RAS G12 mutation. ([dana-farber.org](https://www.dana-farber.org/newsroom/news-releases/2026/fda-approves-daraxonrasib-for-metastatic-pancreatic-cancer-following-landmark-clinical-trial-led-by-dana-farber?utm_source=openai))
   - **Complete or near-complete disappearance on imaging**: In a smaller, earlier stage trial of 61 advanced disease patients, roughly **1 in 12** had imaging scans in which the disease became undetectable. Also, in that group, ~90% had halted tumor growth, and ~60% had tumors reduced or disappeared. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai))

4. **What was not established**:
   - Those whose tumors became undetectable on imaging are **not proven cured**. Researchers note that undetectable disease on scans does *not* guarantee all cancer cells are eliminated. Follow-up duration matters. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai))
   - Durability beyond the documented median follow-up (from phase III ~18 months or so) remains to be established. The length of control of disease or long-term survival beyond what was observed is not fully known. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai))

---

## Comparison with the media/claim

| Claim | Matches evidence? |
|---|---|
| “Tumors disappeared” / “disease made to disappear” | Partially: in imaging scans in some patients (≈8% in the small study of 61); also “substantial tumor shrinkage or disappearance” in ~33% in larger trial. |
| “Major advance in decades” | Supported: multiple sources (e.g. Cancer Research UK) and commentary call it “the biggest breakthrough” still cautious. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai)) |
| “Oral drug + chemotherapy” | Yes. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai)) |
| “All tumors disappeared” | No. Only a subset had undetectable disease on imaging; most had tumor shrinkage or growth control. |

---

## Completed/Measured Outcomes vs. Announcements

- **Completed outcome**: The Phase III RASolute-302 trial was completed (or at least its outcomes have been reported), showing improved overall survival and response rate. The FDA approval is also a completed regulatory outcome. ([dana-farber.org](https://www.dana-farber.org/newsroom/news-releases/2026/fda-approves-daraxonrasib-for-metastatic-pancreatic-cancer-following-landmark-clinical-trial-led-by-dana-farber?utm_source=openai))
- **Still planned / needing more data**: Longer-term follow-up to assess durability of responses; studies in earlier‐stage disease or to assess whether imaging “undetectable” corresponds to lasting remission or cure. ([infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net](https://infobae-infobae-prod.web.arc-cdn.net/america/ciencia-america/2026/11/21/un-medicamento-oral-hizo-desaparecer-tumores-de-pancreas-en-un-ensayo-clinico-es-el-mayor-avance-en-decadas/?utm_source=openai))

---

## Primary & Independent Sources

- **Primary source**: New England Journal of Medicine article on RASolute-302 trial, reported at ASCO 2026. ([dana-farber.org](https://www.dana-farber.org/newsroom/news-releases/2026/fda-approves-daraxonrasib-for-metastatic-pancreatic-cancer-following-landmark-clinical-trial-led-by-dana-farber?utm_source=openai))
- **Independent corroboration**: AP News, Yale Medicine, BMJ, The Guardian etc. have also covered and independently described the results. ([apnews.com](https://apnews.com/article/62537cbc43c5286edb4c00806dc1c2de?utm_source=openai))

---

## Conclusion

- It is true that *daraxonrasib* plus chemotherapy has shown significant results: improved median survival for metastatic pancreatic cancer, tumor shrinkage in a substantial subset, and in some patients, imaging‐based disappearance of detectable tumors.  
- However, the claim that tumors are “gone” in general, or that people are cured, is **not** fully established. Those are promising signs, but **measured outcomes** so far confirm survival improvement and partial or sometimes complete imaging responses—not universal disappearance or confirmed cure.  

If you like, I can pull the exact NEJM paper and quote response rates and survival curves, to give you the full scientific data.

Pancreatic cancer: New drug results prompt standing ovation at oncology conference
Experimental pill promises new hope for deadly pancreatic cancer

stories.research_notes:
Here’s what I found in researching the claim: “Volunteer network helps homeless individuals” in Brazil, particularly relating to the hinted Tribuna do Norte article. I could not find a primary source matching that headline published on November 21, 2026; I did locate several similar stories with concrete outcomes, which may overlap with or relate to the claimed story. Below is a summary, with distinctions between completed outcomes vs. announcements or ongoing efforts.

---

## ✅ Confirmed stories / concrete completed outcomes

### 1. Natal inaugurates 24-hour shelter facility  
- On **March 17, 2026**, the city of Natal (Rio Grande do Norte) opened a **new public unit** for continuous, 24-hour shelter for adults and families in homelessness. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/natal-inaugura-servico-24h-de-acolhimento-para-pessoas-em-situacao-de-rua/?utm_source=openai))  
- The unit offers: food, hygiene, storage of personal belongings, documentation support, psychosocial and pedagogical services. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/natal-inaugura-servico-24h-de-acolhimento-para-pessoas-em-situacao-de-rua/?utm_source=openai))  
- Capacity: up to 80 people; includes facilities such as kitchen, laundry, refection hall, shared sanitary facilities. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/natal-inaugura-servico-24h-de-acolhimento-para-pessoas-em-situacao-de-rua/?utm_source=openai))  

### 2. Inter-institutional mutirão in Natal serves over 400 people street-living  
- On **August 16, 2026**, a coordinated initiative (“Mutirão PopRuaJud Poti”) took place at the Fraternidade Católica Toca de Assis in Natal. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/mais-de-400-pessoas-em-situacao-de-rua-recebem-atendimento-em-acao-interinstitucional/?utm_source=openai))  
- Result: **more than 400 persons in street situations** received assistance (including legal aid from special courts, medical exams for INSS, haircuts, clothing, manicure, support for ex-prisoners and those with substance dependency). ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/mais-de-400-pessoas-em-situacao-de-rua-recebem-atendimento-em-acao-interinstitucional/?utm_source=openai))  

### 3. Projeto Cactus distribution of meals in Natal  
- On **December 20, 2025**, Projeto Cactus held a “caravana” distributing **1,000 meals** to people living on the streets of Natal. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/projeto-cactus-realiza-caravana-com-distribuicao-de-mil-refeicoes-para-moradores-de-rua-em-natal/?utm_source=openai))  
- Staffed by ~100 volunteers; route passed through various vulnerable points (Cidade Alta, Favela do Detran, Cidade de Deus). ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/projeto-cactus-realiza-caravana-com-distribuicao-de-mil-refeicoes-para-moradores-de-rua-em-natal/?utm_source=openai))  

---

## ⚠️ Partially matching but not exactly the candidate claim

Several articles from *Tribuna do Norte* and other sources discuss volunteer networks helping homeless people or people in extreme vulnerability, but:

- **No article found with the exact headline** “Rede de voluntários ajuda pessoas que moram na rua” on the date **November 21, 2026**, or close to that time.  
- Some versions may be announcements or descriptions of ongoing efforts rather than reporting completed outcomes.

Examples:

- **Toca de Assis** in Natal: runs monthly “Manhã de Convivência” serving over 100 people; offers medical, hygiene, food services, etc. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/toca-de-assis-une-solidariedade-e-fe-durante-a-quaresma-em-natal/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Alimentando com Amor**: project by Cida Lima where she houses people, provides meals daily (~40 people daily) and accepts others for food and hygiene services; occurred before August 2023. ([tribunadonorte.com.br](https://tribunadonorte.com.br/natal/projeto-ajuda-quem-vive-nas-ruas/?utm_source=openai))  

---

## 📋 Assessment relative to candidate claim

| Element | Evidence found | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| **Country** | Brazil (Rio Grande do Norte, Natal) | ✅ confirmed |
| **Community / Volunteer network helping homeless** | Multiple examples, especially with “Projeto Cactus”, “Toca de Assis”, “Alimentando com Amor”, and inter-institutional mutirões | ✅ confirmed |
| **Timing: Nov 21, 2026** | No articles found with that exact date or very close matching event on that date | ❓ not confirmed |
| **Original or primary source** | *Tribuna do Norte* is original publisher in many cases; some projects documented in NGO sites or via the local government announcements | ✅ partly (for other dates) |
| **Completed/measured outcome** | Yes: e.g. 1,000 meals delivered; 400+ people served; 80-person shelter opened; etc. | ✅ confirmed in related stories |

---

## 🔍 Conclusion

- The general claim — that a volunteer network helps people experiencing homelessness in Brazil — **is true**, and is supported by multiple verified actions (meal distribution, shelter services, outreach, legal and health assistance) especially in Natal / Rio Grande do Norte.  
- However, **the specific story as phrased** ("Rede de voluntários ajuda pessoas que moram na rua", published on **Nov 21, 2026** by Tribuna do Norte) **was not found** in my searches; I found no article on that exact date matching those terms.  
- It’s possible the candidate headline is a summarization or transformation of one of the articles, but I cannot locate a primary source with that title and date.

---

If you like, I can try checking regional archives or the full Tribuna do Norte editions for November 21, 2026 to see if something was missed, to confirm whether the candidate claim corresponds to a real article. Want me to do that?

Here is a factual research note on the event **“Community partners distribute thousands of meals in Boston”** (Boston, USA, November 21, 2026):

---

### What Happened

- On **Saturday, November 21, 2026**, Catholic Charities Boston and the United Way of Massachusetts Bay, with support from The Greater Boston Food Bank, distributed **2,700 Thanksgiving meals** in Dorchester, Boston. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  
- The distribution included turkeys and all the traditional Thanksgiving sides. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  
- The site of pickup was along Columbia Road in Dorchester. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  

---

### Broader Regional Outcome

- Across the region, a total of **12,500 Thanksgiving meals** will be distributed ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday, serving **13 communities**. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  

---

### Context and Need

- Catholic Charities Boston reports seeing a **40% increase** in demand at its Dorchester pantry. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  
- Nearly **200,000 people in Massachusetts** have lost access to SNAP benefits since **July of last year**, due to eligibility restrictions and changes in funding. Combined with rising costs, this has exacerbated food insecurity. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  

---

### Sources & Verification

- The primary source is the Boston 25 News article by Alyssa Azzara, published **November 21, 2026**, which details the numbers, participants, location, and context. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  
- Catholic Charities Boston’s own website provides additional related information, including details of its Thanksgiving distribution operations. ([ccab.org](https://www.ccab.org/news/boston-college-athletics-kicks-off-catholic-charities-bostons-thanksgiving-distribution/?form=DonateNow&utm_source=openai))  

---

### Completed/Measured Outcome vs. Pledge or Plan

- This is a **completed** event: 2,700 meals were distributed on that Saturday in Dorchester as part of the broader Thanksgiving distribution effort. ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  
- The larger figure, 12,500 meals in 13 communities, is also presented as a planned or ongoing distribution before Thanksgiving (but the 2,700 are confirmed as given) ([boston25news.com](https://www.boston25news.com/news/local/community-partners-distribute-thousands-meals-boston-saturday-amid-growing-need/ZHHTFRDJBJFE7GVBMMOEL3D5BI/?utm_source=openai))  

---

If you’d like, I can pull up photographic evidence, quotes from community members, or compare similar efforts in past years.

### Research note

- **What happened:** On **November 21, 2026**, the Anthony Wayne Area Council held its fifth annual Project 216 meal-packing event at Gethsemane Lutheran Church in Fort Wayne. WPTA reports that about **40 scouts and family members** packed shelf-stable meals for nearly three hours, intended for people in northeast Indiana and elsewhere. ([21alivenews.com](https://www.21alivenews.com/2026/11/21/around-40-volunteers-help-pack-meals-hungry-malnourished-northeast-indiana/))
- **Outcome evidence:** This is reported as a completed event, but the article gives **no total meal count** or distribution tally. It says a Project 216 volunteer packs an average of 216 meals; that is an average, not a measured count for this event. The “up to 16,000 or more” figure refers to past events, not this one. ([21alivenews.com](https://www.21alivenews.com/2026/11/21/around-40-volunteers-help-pack-meals-hungry-malnourished-northeast-indiana/))
- **Source check:** WPTA is the only independent report I found specifically about this event. The Anthony Wayne Area Council’s calendar also listed a “Project 216 – Volunteer opportunity” for November 21, but that is a schedule listing, not confirmation of the completed outcome.
